name: inkwave
description: Inkwave: a neon-arcade multiplayer drawing and guessing game

scripts.build: npm run build -w client && npm run build -w server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w shared && npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w client
scripts.e2e: node e2e/lobby.cjs && node e2e/full-game.cjs && node e2e/resilience.cjs
